            end
            if puddle.Parent then

            end
        end)
    end

        task.delay(0.08, function()

            TweenService:Create(

        for _, conn in ipairs(WeatherConnections) do

        WeatherConnections = {}

        for _, thread in ipairs(WeatherThreads) do
            task.cancel(thread)
        end
        WeatherThreads = {}

        for _, part in ipairs(WeatherObjects.parts or {}) do
            if part.Parent then
                local tween = TweenService:Create(
                    part,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                    {Size = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)}
                )
                tween:Play()
                Debris:AddItem(part, 2)
            end
        end

        if WeatherObjects.sound and WeatherObjects.sound.Parent then
            local tween = TweenService:Create(
                WeatherObjects.sound,
                TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),
                {Volume = 0}
            )
            tween:Play()
            Debris:AddItem(WeatherObjects.sound, 2)
        end

        for _, name in ipairs({"WeatherBlur", "WeatherColor", "WeatherBloom"}) do
            local fx = Lighting:FindFirstChild(name)
            if fx then
                local target = {Size = 0}
                if fx:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                    target = {Contrast = 0, Saturation = 0}
                elseif fx:IsA("BloomEffect") then
                    target = {Intensity = 0}
                end
                local tween = TweenService:Create(
                    fx,
                    TweenInfo.new(1.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.In),

                tween:Play()
                Debris:AddItem(fx, 2)

                Lighting,
                TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),

        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
